summary: Today's briefing highlights key legal rulings and significant developments in the retail sector, particularly focusing on tax judgments and e-commerce growth.

bullets.text: ITAT Mumbai ruled Tata Sons can deduct interest on borrowed capital under Section 36(1)(iii), dismissing Revenue's appeal.
Supreme Court defers decision on compelled disclosure of device passwords, leaving the matter to the Delhi High Court.
Amazon reported $27 billion in cumulative e-commerce exports from India, driven by home textiles and apparel.
Bikaji Foods launched its premium bakery brand Mahè, expanding into a new market segment.
Kalyan Krishnamurthy is leaving Flipkart after over 11 years, during which the business grew more than fivefold.
